messages:
joel: Quick: partner asked for an interoperability checklist between Snowflake Streams, Databricks Autoloader, and a Qdrant vector replica. We should standardize connectors docs.
anya: I propose a one-page diagram + 6-step runbook. Minimizes back-and-forth.
priya: Make sure to include SNAPSHOT/CDC considerations and small-batch latency tuning. Many partners hit throttling if they do full-table snapshots.
sam: I'll add notes on the egress IPs and connector heartbeats. Also recommend short-lived AWS credentials for partner testing.
joel: Also: add a sample performance matrix for table sizes 10k, 100k, 1M rows showing expected ingest TPS and average 50th/95th token latency.
anya: I'll draft the diagram and the runbook: steps: 1) provision sandbox 2) seed data 3) setup connector with role mapping 4) run smoke harness 5) tune batching 6) sign-off.
priya: include a snippet for Snowflake Streams to push changes to an external function that posts to our ingest endpoint. Example:
```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE STREAM retail_stream ON TABLE raw.retail;
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK ext_fn_trigger WAREHOUSE = ws WHEN SYSTEM$STREAM_HAS_DATA('raw.retail')
AS CALL EXTERNAL_FUNCTION('redwood.ingest', (SELECT * FROM TABLE_GENERATOR(1)));
```
sam: deploy-bot: interoperability-checklist job created by sam -> job id interop-558 :gear:
joel: Action: Anya to create PR against docs/connectors with diagram + runbook (due Mon). Priya to add CDC snippet and throttling advice (due Mon). Sam to provide sandbox terraform module (due Tue).
anya: I'll add an appendix with vector DB configuration tips: qdrant: max_segment_row_count, wal settings; milvus: index_build_params.
priya: Good call. Also add guidance on embedding batch sizes by model family and expected tokenization costs.
joel: Let's avoid coupling to any single partner infra in the doc. Use neutral examples and clearly mark partner-specific sections.
anya: will do. I'll tag partner-eng and eng-ml in the PR for review.
priya: Thanks all. Short and practical is what partners appreciate. :thumbsup:
